name: Wyrmlings
description: A clutch of newly hatched dragons. As newborns, they’re furious, hungry, and stupid.

abilities.name: Horde (2d6+5)
abilities.description: When the Wyrmlings have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d6+5 physical damage instead.

abilities.name: Ravenous
abilities.description: Once per GM turn when a PC marks a HP from an attack made by the Wyrmlings, you can spend a Fear to spotlight the Wyrmlings again.

abilities.name: Overwhelm
abilities.description: When the Wyrmlings take Minor damage from an attack within Melee range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack with advantage against the attacker.
